generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Successful bidder shall furnish within 20 days from issue of letter of acceptance before entering in to agreement, a Copy of Income Tax returns filed mentioning PAN for the financial year 2025-26 (Assessment year 2026-27) prior to date of entering in to the agreement. Failing which the EMD amount will be forfeited and the tender will be rejected and the bidder shall liable for subsequent penal action including black listing
The amount put to tender is exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote without GST. However, G.S.T will be paid at prevailing rate during billing.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders.

The tenderer shall have insurance coverage to his personnel to meet against all risk including Electrical and Mechanical accidents while performing the work and operations at the KBJNL substations. The tenderer or his staff are not eligible for any compensation from KBJNL in this regard.
The contractor should carry out the work as per specification, approved drawings and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
The agency has to give performance guarantee of 6000 hours of run or 2 years of satisfactory operation whichever is maximum.
The agency shall comply with the guaranteed parameters as per pump specification/drawing.
The contractor/authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature before uploading the documents.
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever.
Any Modification / clarification will be published in the e-portal web site. The bidders are advised to visit the e portal regularly.

If multiple (L1) bidders quoted lowest same price to the work and the award of work will be done by considering the bidder with highest turnover from the last three completed financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e. Financial Year 2021-22 to 2025-26).

Bidders should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1% (or as modified by Govt. from time to time) cess from the contractors bill under the provisions of building and other constructions worker welfare cess Act 1996.

Successful bidders should execute the agreement within 03 days from the date of approval intimated. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, the EMD of the contractor shall be forfeited and action shall be initiated for barring to participate in the tender of KBJNL.
Any addendum thus issued shall be part of the tender documents and will be communicated through KPP Portal only.

Contractor shall bear the service tax as per the reverse charge mechanism as per Government of India Notification No 30/2012 Service Tax Dated 20-6-2012 and any modifications/charges notified by the Government of India from time to time and on date of payment.

The original certificates/ documents shall be produced to this office within 4 days from the Intimation letter received from the office through WhatsApp/email/post. If the bidder failed to produce the original documents. Hence the bid can be treated as non-responsive
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any Certification/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.
The intending bidder shall upload self-attested letter pad mentioning latest Communication address, land phone & mobile Phone.
Scope of work and other conditions are as mentioned in the tender documents.
The Bidders should Submit the E-portal Up loaded work done certificate by mentioning the work indent no, if not the bid can be treated as non-responsive.
The Security deposit (EMD & FSD) will be withheld as performance guarantee and will be released after the completion of Work/Defect Liability period.
Further information can be had from the undersigned during office hours.
If bidder found involved in corrupt or fraudulent practices will be blacklisted.
As per Govt order No: DPAR 06 PSR 2024 dated:20.05.2024 it should be implemented

The intending bidder should have in last 5 years i.e. from 2021-22 to 2025-26, satisfactorily completed (not less than 90% of contract value) as a prime contractor, one similar work costing not less than 50% of the amount put to tender in last five years of value Rs.168.75 lakh (337.50 lakh / 2).The work done certificate should be obtained duly signed from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division and counter signed by the Superintending Engineer of the same circle or equivalent in case of other Government undertaking within India. The cost will be updated to the present value by giving a weight age of 10% for each year, if the work is completed prior to FY 2026-27.Note- Similar work means Supply, Install,Testing & commissioning of 6.6kv class & above VT Pump with HT Induction Motor. (or) AME of LIS including Repair/Restoration/ Overhauling of 6.6kV class & above VT Pump/ HT Induction Motor.Work done certificate to be uploaded should have following information:1.Date of Agreement (Date :----)2.Agreement Period(----Months) 3.Contract / Agreement Value(Rs.---lakhs). 4.Amount of work executed(Rs.---lakhs.) 5.% of Fin. Progress w.r.t. Contract value%.6.Date of completion of work.Date : ----Copies of Last RA Bill / Final RA Bill shall be uploaded in e-procurement in support of work done certificate.

The intending bidder should have executed the following minimum quantities.1.Supply, Install,Testing & commissioning of 6.6kV class & above VT Pump with HT Induction Motor.(or) Repair/Restoration/ Overhauling of 6.6kV class & above VT Pump/ HT Induction Motor 2Nos.The work done certificate should be obtained duly signed from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division and counter signed by the Superintending Engineer of the same Circle or Equivalent in case of other Government undertaking.
The intending bidders should have a valid Class-1 and above CEIG Registered Electrical Contractor license.
Valid Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate.
Valid GST Registration Certificate mandatory.

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualification criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value Rs. 337.50 lakh. The available tender Capacity will be calculated as under BID CAPACITY- AxNx1.5 -B. where, A -Maximum value of civil engineering works Executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N- Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B -Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 24 months (Period of completion of the works for which tenders are invited). Note-1: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be certified by Statutory Auditors of the Company or by the proprietor of the company through an affidavit. Note-2: Even though the Tenderers meet the above criteria they are subject to be disqualified if they have: (a) made misleading or false representation in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and / or (b) record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history or financial failure etc, and / or (c) Participated in the previous tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification. (d) If the bidder / bidders have participated in more than one work, the available tender capacity will be assessed and number of works will be awarded as per his available bid capacity.

The intending bidder in his / its name should have in the last 5 years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least 2 financial years, a minimum financial turnover of Rs.337.50 lakh (usually not less than two times the estimated annual payments under this contract) (Rs. 337.50 lakh x 2 x 12 months / 24 months). The turnover prior to FY 2025-26 will be updated to the Present Price Level ()by giving weight age of 10% each year. Audited Profit and Loss account certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant bearing UDIN along with copy of Income Tax returns filed for the years indicated above should be furnished. ()FY 2026-27.
